rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice, especially when someone narrowly avoids a bad outcome.

example.english: I was fortunate to catch the train.
example.jyutping: hou2 coi2 ngo5 gon2 dak1 cit3 baan1 ce1

rows.note: Use this for the more general idea of being favored by fortune, especially in formal or written contexts.

example.english: I feel very fortunate to have this opportunity.
example.traditional: 能夠獲得呢個機會，我感到非常幸運。
example.jyutping: nang4 gau3 wok6 dak1 ni1 go3 gei1 wui6 ngo5 gam2 dou3 fei1 soeng4 hang6 wan6
